notes.title: New game modes have arrived!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982193/fa73d7103dfda56282164cde43fc8b092ed993f7.png

I am pleased to announce the rollout of 5 different game modes!

Most Kills: Points are awarded for each kill
Last Afloat: A point is awarded to the last player alive
One Shot: Play with only 1 cannonball per player
Hardcore: No bonus treasure, shots come fully charged
Submerged: All players are submarines


Please let me know if you have any other game mode ideas,
Trevor
